categories.evidence: No real WooCommerce store or production-value customer is connected.

Six versioned earning sources, conditions, exclusions, precedence, caps, signed activity, and three reward types exist; referrals, campaigns, communications, migration, advanced VIP, and enterprise breadth do not.

The Hub shell, focused programme workflows, source-safe earning-rule catalogue, conflict review, and exact simulator pass responsive production QA; advanced campaign, referral, approval, and fulfilment operations remain incomplete.
Hosted balances, history, and redemption exist; discovery, referrals, progress, communications, and broad store placements are incomplete.
Immutable ledger, idempotency, RLS, bounded queues, compensation, and runtime matrix pass; real-store outage and full recovery proof remain.
Queue health, support bundle, WAL/base backup, worker leases, and production deployment exist; full clean-room application/Auth/secret recovery and load evidence remain.

Authentik workforce SSO plus database-authoritative deployment modes, entitlements, protected paths, exact limits, and tenant rollout exist; tenant SSO/SCIM, agency controls, metering, and managed billing do not.
